clubs.description: The Undergraduate Theater Society works to support and expand the academic theater community within the UW undergraduate community and the UW School of Drama. We strive to offer rich artistic and practical opportunities to the undergraduate theater community at the University of Washington by providing human, financial, and technical resources. By producing engaging theatre, we strive to explore the lived experiences of our diverse world.

clubs.name: United Nations Association University of Washington Chapter
clubs.about: We are dedicated to educating, inspiring, and mobilizing students to support the principles and vital work of the UN…
clubs.description: We are dedicated to educating, inspiring, and mobilizing students to support the principles and vital work of the UN and strengthen the UN system. We advocate for the UN, stand up for human rights, and learn how to meet UN sustainability goals.

clubs.name: UW Recreation
clubs.about: University recreation department offering activities for student wellbeing.
clubs.description: UW Recreation provides a wide range of activities to support student health and fun, from climbing classes to paddle‑board events. They offer a one‑day Belay Techniques class and seasonal events like the Witches Paddle with equipment supplied. All programs aim to be safe, accessible, and welcoming.

clubs.name: @uw_oscmc
clubs.about: Student club focused on supply chain and operations management.
clubs.description: OSCMC hosts networking events for students interested in supply chain and operations. Their Fall Networking Night offers meaningful conversations and insights into the field. Connect with peers and professionals to expand your knowledge.

clubs.name: @uw_stf
clubs.about: Provides funding support and proposal guidance for student projects.
clubs.description: The @uw_stf club offers workshops to guide students through the proposal and funding process. Their Fall Quarter Proposal Workshop helps members craft strong project proposals.

clubs.name: Viable Veganism at UW
clubs.about: Animal Advocacy at UW as a goal of creating a strong community of students passionate about reducing animal cruelty.
clubs.description: Animal Advocacy at UW as a goal of creating a strong community of students passionate about reducing animal cruelty. We welcome everyone.

clubs.name: VSAUW
clubs.about: Vietnamese student association fostering community and culture.
clubs.description: VSAUW is the Vietnamese Student Association at UW, offering cultural events, info nights, and community gatherings. Members celebrate Vietnamese heritage, connect with peers, and enjoy activities throughout the semester.

clubs.name: Washington Public Interest Research Group
clubs.about: WashPIRG is a a nonpartisan, studentrun organization dedicated to making a difference on issues students care about.
clubs.description:
WashPIRG is a a nonpartisan, studentrun organization dedicated to making a difference on issues students care about. We give students the skills and opportunities to mobilize and advocate for social change.
Get involved at washpirgstudents.org!

clubs.about: Our purpose is to build a community of Magic: The Gathering players at UW and to run weekly events encompassing a…
clubs.description: Our purpose is to build a community of Magic: The Gathering players at UW and to run weekly events encompassing a variety of different formats. Join the discord to learn more about how to get involved here https://discord.gg/Mfmg84f

clubs.name: Women Empowerment through Collaborations, Awareness, and Resources for Education
clubs.about: WECARE works to empower women globally through expanding resources for health, education, and more.
clubs.description: WECARE works to empower women globally through expanding resources for health, education, and more. We aim to create an environment where students from all backgrounds and identities can gain a sense of community together between shared values. Through workshops, outreach, and collaborations with community partners, we aim to close knowledge gaps and reduce stigma surrounding topics that are often overlooked in traditional education. We understand that education is empowerment. WECARE is one of the founding RSOs of the Pregnancy Test Access Project, bringing free pregnancy tests to UW's campus, available for all students! More info on our Instagram @wecareuw.

clubs.name: Women’s Rugby at UW
clubs.about: UW women's rugby team open to all interested players.
clubs.description: Womxn’s Husky Rugby Club fields a competitive women’s rugby team open to all interested players. The club posts game updates, practices, and fun team activities like themed costume practices.

clubs.name: Woof3D
clubs.about: As the 3D printing club at UW, we provide a hub for anyone interested in 3D printing.
clubs.description: As the 3D printing club at UW, we provide a hub for anyone interested in 3D printing. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, we have something for everyone. Experience is not required, and neither is any time commitment. During Fall Quarter, we hold weekly workshops mostly aimed towards beginners. These will teach the basics of 3D modeling in OnShape, as well as how to print using the club printers. We also provide members with the opportunity to work on a larger scale 3D printing project with other members throughout the year. Joining a team is not required, but it is a good way to get hands on experience and learn more about hardware and software in the process. Check out our website to learn more!

clubs.name: Writers in Progress
clubs.about: Interested in creative writing?
clubs.description: Interested in creative writing? We create a positive, casual space where people interested in a variety of forms of creative writing can meet and provide each other with support and feedback. Bring something to share or just come to chat! :)
